acceptance_criteria: The V1R failure seal verifies and contributed zero seeds, epochs, optimizer steps, C09/C10 reads and reusable partial assets.
Before model loading, the executable exists and its exact environment versions plus live sorted pip-freeze SHA-256 match the frozen contract.
All three source seals, checkpoints, tools and Data Card match; seeds 0/1/2 each run exactly ten epochs with 3000 Cano and 3000 AEE samples per epoch.
Every seed has AEE direction F1 at least B0, empty rate at most 0.05, count and role macro-F1 each at least 0.70, and Cano direction F1 loss at most 0.02.
Encoder/embedding tensor hashes and fixed z_role probes are exactly unchanged, semantic heads change, C09 remains retention/exact-tie-only, and C10/later reads are zero.
All three seeds pass or the one V1R2 run fails and seals without retry or partial promotion.
baseline: Per seed, frozen AEE garage range-sector B0 is the direction baseline and the source M1D checkpoint on Cano C09 is the retention baseline. V1R is the sealed system-failure predecessor with zero training and no reusable partial result.

estimated_cost.compute: Three serial RTX 5090 D head-only jobs, expected 1-2 GPU hours, internal hard limit 4 hours; zero simulation.

expected_evidence: V1R failure reference plus exact input, executable, live environment and pip-freeze integrity record.
Per-seed histories/checkpoints, AEE validation outputs and metrics, Cano source/adapted retention, frozen tensor hashes, z_role probes and read counters.
Aggregate metrics, raw logs, progress, RUN_STATE, duration/size and SHA-256 evidence seal.
method: Path-only replacement for sealed V1R: verify the candidate Python environment and live sorted pip freeze before model loading, then run the unchanged seed 0/1/2 head-only trainer for ten epochs with exactly 3000 AEE and 3000 Cano samples per epoch. Freeze encoder and embedding_head; select by AEE garage direction F1, Cano C09 direction F1 only on an exact tie, AEE role F1 and earliest epoch.
question: Can the unchanged three-seed head-only adaptation learn AEE structural semantics while preserving the frozen representation and Cano performance when executed in a verified equivalent sidecar?
replacement_reason: V1R failed before model loading because its /tmp phase3 sidecar executable was absent; completed seeds, epochs, optimizer steps and C09/C10 reads were zero.
stop_conditions: Any parent seal, source, checkpoint, tool, executable, environment, pip-freeze, data, module-freeze or hyperparameter drift.
Any per-seed metric failure, nondeterministic-operation error, CUDA failure, C09 misuse, C10/later read, timeout or disk-limit violation.
Any retry, threshold change, partial reuse, seed deletion, teacher change, model search or representation unfreeze.
system_contract_changes: Use a non-overwriting persistent clone of the verified sidecar; make the executable spec-driven and fail before model loading unless exact live versions, sorted pip-freeze SHA-256 and pip check all pass.
